# Central Command Enforcement Officer
1. Your direct superior is the Central Command Representative.
2. Central Command Enforcers are to ensure the safety of Central Command staff, the Captain, the Research Director, and the rest of the Nanotrasen Command staff on station by any means necessary, in that order.
3. Central Command Enforcers are to execute the orders of their superiors by any means necessary.
4. Central Command Enforcers are to ensure the safety of vital station assets, these include the Nuclear Authentication Disk, the Research Server, the Central Command Representative’s briefcase, and other vital equipment by any means necessary.
5. The Central Command Enforcer is not a member of the NanoTrasen Station Security team. As such, they are not to perform or execute the duties of a Security Officer or become actively engaged in conflicts outside the scope of their assigned tasks. The Enforcer is allowed to arrest, restrain and remove other involved personnel if they are interfering with their mission.
6. The Central Command Enforcer cannot and should not interfere with the lawful arrest of a member of Command.
7. The Central Command Enforcement Officer may carry out a Magistrate or Central Command issued punitive judgement if the station's security team fails to do so.
